messages:
alex (product): FYI team - Private 2.5 pilot invites going out today to 25 partners. Key items: BYO-Networking pilot (preview), FIPS module as opt-in, and a data-residency routing toggle. Not a mandatory upgrade yet.

priya (cs): Thanks. CSMs need a one-page checklist + approved email copy. Can we include clear guidance on backup/rollback for customers who are air-gapped?

alex (product): Yes. We'll include rollback steps and an explicit "no automatic telemetry upload" line for air-gapped installs. Draft docs: https://confluence.redwood.ai/private-2.5-pilot-notes (internal).

marco (security): Security note: FIPS mode enforces TLS1.2+ with a restricted cipher suite and disables legacy KDFs. Customers must upload FIPS attestation if they enable it. I'll share the attestation template.

rachel (legal): Add a short clause on customer responsibilities for key custody in BYO-Networking pilots. We should require an SLA acknowledgement for pilot participants.

nate (eng-ops): Pilot rollout plan: week 0 invites + docs, week 1 onboarding and canary (5 tenants), week 2 increase to 50%, then full pilot. Agent updates optional; most customers can stay on 2.4.x until they opt-in. For on-prem upgrades we'll provide an offline installer and upgrade script.

priya (cs): Can we get a short command snippet for customers who want to enable BYO-Networking after upgrade? Support needs copy.

nate (eng-ops): Adding snippet: 

```bash
# enable BYO networking on the control plane (customer-managed)
redwoodctl tenancy update --id <TENANT_ID> --set private.byo_networking=true
# enable FIPS (opt-in)
redwoodctl tenancy update --id <TENANT_ID> --set security.fips_mode=enabled
```

marco (security): Reminder: enabling FIPS will trigger a cert rotation. Rotation can be kicked manually with: `redwoodctl cert rotate --tenant <TENANT_ID>`

priya (cs): We'll prepare a customer-facing FAQ. Top Qs: "Will Redwood access my data in BYO?" "What happens if agent loses connectivity?"

alex (product): Quick answers for the FAQ: BYO-Networking keeps customer-hosted models and traffic on customer network; control-plane interactions are minimized. If agent loses connectivity and fallback is enabled, traffic can be routed to Redwood hosted endpoints (only for customers who opt in).

support-bot: Pilot invites dispatched to partner list: pilot-2026-25. Ticket template created: #PILOT-2026-25.

rachel (legal): CSM please collect the signed pilot acknowledgement before onboarding. I'll attach the legal template to the confluence doc.

priya (cs): Copy that. We'll also ask customers for a point of contact for their network/security team.

nate (eng-ops): Monitoring hooks we'll expose during the pilot: agent.health, network.egress, controlplane.heartbeat, and fips.mode_status. We'll emit a small telemetry blob only if customers opt in (default: off for air-gapped).

marco (security): One more - customers enabling BYO must confirm they allow inbound connections from our support CIDR for troubleshooting, or agree to an offline support workflow.

alex (product): Timeline: doc + emails today, onboarding sessions next Tue/Thu, pilot runs for 30 days. If no major issues we'll promote to GA in the next release cycle.

priya (cs): I'll coordinate session times and share calendar invites. Also prepping a short training for support staff.

nate (eng-ops): Adding operations playbook for support (will post in #support once ready).

alex (product): Thanks all. If you need approvals from leadership for pilot participants, ping me. We'll monitor signals: customer enable rate, incidents, and support load.

support-bot: Reminder: collect pilot acknowledgements within 7 days of invite.
